entities.summary: The Possibilists, also called Broussists, were a faction of the French socialist movement led by Paul Brousse. Benoît Malon and others supported the faction although they did not always fully share its inspiring principles. It originated within the "Federation of the Socialist Workers' Party of France", a Marxist-inspired organisation founded by Paul Lafargue, Jules Guesde and others, in Marseille, in 1879.
